title: Lead Research Specialist (Influencers, Brands & Online Communities)
description:

We create unique plush products in collaboration with influencers, fandoms, and companies — and we are looking for a Research Specialist to help us find the best potential partners.





========================================

ROLE OVERVIEW

========================================



Your main task is to research and identify high-quality leads (potential partners) who would be a great fit for custom plush toy collaborations.



You will explore the internet, find promising creators/brands, and gather the most important information about them.





========================================

RESPONSIBILITIES

========================================



• Research and identify potential partners:



- YouTubers, Twitch streamers, TikTok creators

- Bands and musicians

- Online communities and fandoms

- Video game developers

- Brands and companies



• Collect and organize key information:



- Contact details 
, social media, websites)

- Audience size and engagement

- Niche relevance and brand fit

- Best way to contact (manager,
, DMs, etc.)



• Continuously improve research quality and find better opportunities





========================================

IMPORTANT: UNDERSTANDING WHAT MAKES A GOOD LEAD

========================================



We are NOT simply looking for creators with large audiences.



We are specifically looking for creators, brands, games, mascots, characters, or communities that can realistically be turned into strong plush products that fans would actually want to buy.



A good lead usually has:



- Recognizable characters, mascots, avatars, creatures, or visual identities

- Strong emotional connection between audience and character

- 
able, cute, funny, iconic, or collectible visual elements

- Existing fandom culture around specific characters or designs



Examples of weak leads:



- Generic beauty influencers with no recognizable mascot/character

- Creators whose content is only their real-life personality without visual branding

- Random large gaming communities without a clear character or mascot



Examples of strong leads:



- Creators with animated personas, mascots, or lore

- Games with recognizable creatures or characters

- Communities built around iconic designs or 
s

- Brands with mascots or collectible-style aesthetics



The most important question is:



“Can this realistically become a plush toy that fans would immediately recognize and want to collect?”





========================================

REQUIREMENTS

========================================



• Good English skills

• Good internet research skills

• High attention to detail

• Good understanding of social media platforms (YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Instagram, etc.)

• Ability to understand niche communities and fanbases

• Ability to identify trends and promising creators





========================================

WORKING HOURS

========================================



• 3 hours per day

• Flexible schedule (please include your availability)





========================================

HOW TO APPLY

========================================



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your relevant experience

3. Your
 and other contact information



5. REQUIRED: Include 3 sample leads you personally researched.



For EACH sample lead, you MUST include:



- Who the creator/brand/community is

- Links/socials

- Why you believe they are a strong fit for plush merchandise

- WHAT specifically could be turned into a plush product

- Why fans would likely buy it



Very important:



Answers like “they have a big community” or “they are popular in gaming” are NOT enough.



We want to see clear thinking about the actual plush potential.



Good applications explain things like:



- Specific characters or mascots

- 
s, creatures, avatars, or visual branding

- Emotional attachment within the fandom

- Why the design would work physically as a plush

- Why it would feel collectible or appealing to fans



We are looking for someone detail-oriented, curious, and motivated to find great opportunities.

title: TikTok KOL Supervisor
description:
Job Overview:

We are seeking a dynamic and highly motivated KOL Manager to oversee and grow our TikTok influencer marketing efforts in Philippines. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and managing relationships with TikTok influencers to drive brand awareness, engagement, and ultimately sales in the local market.

Key Responsibilities:

1. KOL Strategy Development:

  - Develop and implement a comprehensive TikTok KOL influencer strategy aligned with brand objectives, market trends, and consumer insights in Vietnam.

  - Create campaigns that drive engagement, brand awareness, and conversion, with clear KPIs and measurable outcomes.

2. KOL Research and Identification:

3. Campaign Execution & Management:

  - Oversee end-to-end influencer campaign execution, from briefing and content creation to final delivery and performance analysis.

4. Collaboration and Negotiation:

  - Negotiate contracts, terms, and compensation with influencers and influencer agencies to ensure mutually beneficial partnerships.

  - Collaborate with internal teams (creative, PR, and marketing) to ensure influencer content is integrated seamlessly into the overall marketing strategy.

5. Performance Tracking and Reporting:

  - Monitor the performance of KOL campaigns on TikTok, track key metrics (engagement, reach, conversions), and optimize strategies accordingly.

6. Community Building:

7. Market and Competitor Insights:

  - Monitor competitors' influencer strategies on TikTok and analyze trends in influencer marketing within Philippine’s digital landscape.

Qualifications:

- Strong understanding of TikTok trends, features, and best practices.

Preferred:

- Existing network of TikTok influencers in Philippines.

title: Account Coordinator | Account Manager | Client Success and Retention
description:
Part-Time to Full-Time · Immediate Start



About Concierge Drop

Concierge Drop is a premium on-demand home services company operating inside NYC luxury residential buildings. Residents book dry cleaning, home cleaning, dog walking, uniform cleaning, and more directly from our website — picked up and delivered from the building lobby. No app required.



We're in 200+ buildings across Manhattan and growing fast. Our 2026 goal is 150 new buildings. This role is at the center of that growth — keeping every building healthy, activated, and moving toward a 10% resident capture rate.



The Role

You are the heartbeat of every building. You look at the data, d
 which buildings need attention, and go activate them.



This starts part-time (~20 hrs/week) and grows into full-time for the right person. This is a pure account coordination role — not sales.



The Sales Coordinator closes new buildings. You own everything from the 
nt a building signs: onboarding, relationships, signage, promotions, events, capture rate growth, and long-term account health. You work directly with the CEO and report to the Chief of Staff.



What You Own

- Building Onboarding: Complete full onboarding checklist within 5 business days of signing. Vendors assigned, supplies delivered, CS notified, digital flyer sent to management, referral links shared.

- Capture Rate Growth: Monitor sign-ups per building weekly. Run a data-driven decision loop: Analyze ? Diagnose ? Prescribe ? Execute ? Repeat. Target: 10?pture rate by month 6 for all new buildings.

- Promo Campaigns: Propose and execute targeted promotions per building. Get approval within 24 hours. Coordinate with management to reach residents. Track before/after results.

- Events: Coordinate welcome events with our 3rd party events team. Track last event date per building — flag any building with no event in 90+ days.

- Building Relationships: Regular check-ins with property managers. Collect and maintain concierge cell numbers. Know every contact across the portfolio.

- Marketing Materials: Create event flyers, promo flyers, and concierge desk flyers. Good eye for design required. All materials approved before distribution.

- Contacts & CRM: Own the Building Inventory Tracker and all HubSpot building records. Every building must have a minimum of 2 contacts and 1 management company association. Keep it current.

- Uniform Cleaning: Collect staff lists, coordinate with assigned vendor, confirm bag delivery, send billing to accounting with effective date.

- Account Management: Monitor capture rate, track revenue share payments, manage renewals (60-day outreach), handle building complaints, flag at-risk accounts.

- Weekly KPI Report: Weekly summary to leadership: buildings onboarded, capture rate movement, at-risk buildings with action plans, promos running, events scheduled, open issues.



Growth Programs You Own

Referral Program — $10 Both Ways (Live, needs activation)

Share resident referral links with leasing managers and resident coordinators. Include in every move-in packet. Both referrer and new resident receive a $10 credit on their first order.

Concierge Incentive Program — $10 Amazon Gift Card (Build from scratch)

Build the concierge contact database — every building needs at least one cell number on file. Triggered when a referred customer spends $50+. When a resident mentions their concierge, capture name and cell immediately.

Move-In Program — Own Every New Resident From Day One

Maintain name and
 of leasing manager and resident coordinator for every building. Digital flyer
ed to management for move-in comms. Physical flyers at front desk (all buildings) and leasing office (rental buildings). Welcome dry cleaning bag delivered to new residents.



Building Priority Tiers

Tier A — High Priority: 150+ units AND under 5?pture rate

Weekly check-ins. Immediate activation plan. Event within 30 days. Promo running. Escalate if no movement after 60 days.

Tier B — Active Growth: 100–149 units OR 5–9?pture rate

Bi-weekly check-ins. Monitor trends. Run promos when triggered. Push toward 10%.

Tier C — Healthy: 100+ units AND 10%+ capture rate

Monthly check-ins. Maintain relationships. Renewal outreach at 60 days. Push toward 15%.

All tiers: minimum one in-person building visit per quarter. Photo documentation required.



What Success Looks Like

30 Days: Every active building reviewed and logged. All property manager contacts and concierge cell numbers on file. Signage status confirmed. First at-risk buildings flagged.

60 Days: Check-in cadence running. First data-driven promo executed and measured. Referral links shared across all buildings. Concierge database started.

90 Days: Zero buildings going quiet without a follow-up plan. 2+ promos run with before/after measurement. Capture rate trending up in 5+ buildings. Fully autonomous. Full-time conversation on the table.

Month 6: All new buildings onboarded since joining are at 10%+ capture rate. Building tier scoring complete. Seasonal promo calendar built. Concierge incentive program active.

\Who You Are

- Philippines-based preferred, but open to candidates who can overlap 4+ hours with EST

- Excellent written and spoken English — you communicate professionally with NYC property managers

- Data-driven — you make decisions based on numbers, not gut

- Organized to a fault — nothing slips, ever

- Good eye for design — you create flyers and promo materials that look sharp and on-brand

- Proactive — you flag problems before they escalate, not after

- Experienced in account management, client success, or customer coordination

- Comfortable with HubSpot, Google Sheets, and Slack — or fast enough to learn

- Thinks like a business owner, not an employee

- Spanish or Tagalog a plus



This role is NOT for you if:

You need constant direction to stay productive

You treat this as a low-commitment side job

You're not comfortable being a primary point of contact for business relationships

You're looking for a sales role — this is pure account coordination



Compensation & Growth

- Rate: $6 per hour

- Part-time to start (~20 hrs/week)

- Clear path to full-time based on performance

- We build long-term with our remote team — our CS Manager is Philippines-based and has been with us since the beginning

title: Web Developer / Designer who actually uses AI tools (Claude Code etc.)
description:
I run a small digital agency in Australia (web dev, design, AI consulting). I'm looking for someone to join the team long-term, starting with a paid trial.

Here's the honest version of the role. I take a brief from the client, then hand it to you. You take it from there and build the app or site out using AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, that kind of thing), follow my process, then properly test it before it comes back to me. I'm not looking for someone who waits to be told every step. I want someone who can run with a brief and bring it home.

I also pick up graphic design work from time to time, so an eye for design genuinely matters here. I'm not after someone who can only follow instructions, I want someone who notices when something looks off and knows how to make it look good.

What you need to be genuinely good at:



AI coding tools, Claude Code especially. If you've never used it, this isn't the role for you. I want someone who already builds this way.

WordPress. Real, hands-on stuff (themes, plugins, page builders, fixing other people's messes). A chunk of my clients are on WordPress, so this isn't optional.

Full-stack development AND design sense. You can build it and make it look good. Most people are one or the other. I need both.

A real eye for design. Layout, spacing, typography, colour. You can look at a design and tell whether it works.

Graphic design tools. Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Figma, whatever you use. I get graphic design tasks too and I need someone who can handle them.

Testing your own work before handing it over. I shouldn't be the one finding the bugs.

Good written English and clear communication. We'll be working closely.



Nice to have:



React or modern frameworks

Experience working to a brand brief, not just inventing your own style

Comfortable working independently across a few projects



The setup:



Remote, working Philippine business hours (we're only 2 hours ahead in Australia, so it lines up well)

Starts as a paid trial (1 to 3 months) so we can both see if it's a fit

If it works, it becomes permanent and ongoing



To apply, do this or I'll skip you:

Start your message with the word "Emerald" so I know you actually read this. Then tell me:



A project you built using Claude Code or similar. What it was and what you did.

Your WordPress experience, with links if you've got them.

A portfolio or a few examples of your work, including any graphic design.



Thanks,

Jake

title: Software Developer
description:
***PLEASE READ ON HOW TO APPLY***



Job Title: Software Developer

Location: Remote | Philippines based ONLY

Salary Range: Php 180,000 per month

A MUST: Minimum of 5 years of solid experience



We’re looking for talented Software Developers to join our remote-first team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for

building and maintaining responsive, high-performing full- stack web applications using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and

Supabase.



Our ideal candidate writes clean, maintainable code, takes ownership of their work, and thrives in a fast-paced

startup environment where autonomy, communication, and craftsmanship are valued.



Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js.

- Work with Supabase (PostgreSQL) to design, query, and optimise relational database schemas.

- Integrate third-party APIs, including reading, understanding, and applying API documentation.

- Implement responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces with Tailwind CSS.

- Utilise AI-powered tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude, and similar) to accelerate development while

maintaining high code quality and exercising sound engineering judgment over AI-generated output.

- Collaborate with other developers and/or stakeholders to refine requirements, propose technical solutions, and deliver features on agreed timelines.

- Work with background jobs and scheduled tasks using Inngest (or similar services) for cron-like and event-driven workflows.

- Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues across the stack, including in production environments.

- Produce clear technical documentation for features, architectural decisions, and processes.

- Communicate proactively and clearly within a remote team, including written updates and participation in online meetings across UK-Philippines time zones.



Must-Have Skills:

- Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React, and Next.js

- Experience with Supabase or relational databases (PostgreSQL)

- Ability to read and integrate third-party API documentation

- Strong understanding of Tailwind CSS and responsive design principles

- Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development workflows

- Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a remote environment

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

- Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools while maintaining engineering judgment and security best practices



Nice-to-Have Skills

- Experience with React Native and mobile development tools (Expo, Xcode, Android Studio)

- Experience with Inngest or similar background job / cron orchestration tools

- Familiarity with Vercel serverless and edge functions



Tech Stack



Primary:

- TypeScript

- React

- Next.js

- Tailwind CSS

- Supabase (PostgreSQL)



Secondary / Bonus:

- React Native

- Expo

- Python



Tools & Platforms:

- Git / GitHub

- Vercel

- Supabase

- Inngest

- Standard remote collaboration tools (Slack/Teams, Jira/Linear or equivalent)



***PLEASE READ ON HOW TO APPLY***



How to Apply:

To apply for this role, please submit a link to your resume and a brief Loom video (max 2 minutes) introducing yourself and highlighting your skills relevant to the role. In your video, please address the following:

- A short introduction of yourself and why you're interested in this role.

- Your previous experience as a Software Developer and specific experience with Next JS/Supabase

- Key skills or qualifications that make you a strong fit for this position.



Please note: Applications without a video will not be reviewed. We look forward to welcoming a passionate developer who prioritizes clean code, performance optimization, and delivering exceptional user experiences.

title: Ecommerce sales rep/customer service
description:
Hiring: Inside Sales & Customer Support Rep (Remote, Full-Time, High-Ticket Ecommerce)

Hi everyone, Facundo here.

I run two small US e-commerce stores: one in commercial water and hydration

systems (drinking fountains and bottle refill stations), and one in outdoor

power and forestry equipment (log splitters, wood chippers, attachments). I'm

looking for one friendly, English-fluent person to be the voice of both stores

on live chat,
, and phone. The heart of the job is sales: helping people

feel confident making a high-ticket purchase, guiding them to the right

product, preparing quotes, and following up so we don't lose them.

One store is established with a light, steady flow of inquiries. The other is

new and growing fast, with strong projections for this year and next. You'd

start by covering both because volume is low. As we grow, you'll focus on just

one.

A few honest things up front:

- The workload is light right now. Think around two live chats and a couple of

calls per store per day, plus preparing quotes.

- You'll have real downtime, especially the first month but you will use this time to learn about the products and systems.

The best people use it to follow up on open quotes and abandoned carts, because

that's where the commission is. This role rewards initiative, not

clock-watching.

- The questions are mostly simple: order status, "which model fits my needs,"

basic product questions. Some technical ones come in. At first you'll pass

those to me; over time you'll handle most yourself.

Because the products are high-ticket (orders from hundreds to several thousand

dollars), the one thing that really matters is clear, confident, natural

English on the phone. You're helping people feel comfortable making a real

purchase. That's the job.

What you'll do:

- Help customers pick the right product, answer their questions, and close the

sale

- Prepare and send quotes, then follow up on them by call and

- Recover abandoned checkouts by reaching out before the lead goes cold

- Answer inbound live chats,
s, and phone calls for both stores

- Call customers after delivery to check in and ask for a Trustpilot review

- Handle the occasional refund, warranty, or shipping question (these are rare)

- Keep simple notes updated in the CRM and pass anything technical to me (at

first)

- Light Shopify tasks as you settle in (optional)

Required:

- Sales experience (any role where you helped someone d
 to buy)

- Customer service experience

-Sales experience

- Strong, natural spoken English and a great attitude (just as important as the

experience)

Strongly preferred:

- Shopify experience (admin, orders, fulfillment)

- Experience selling higher-priced or considered purchases, not just fast retail

Compensation: $600 to $800+/month (base + uncapped commission)

- Base: $600/month at 40 hrs/week

- Commission: 0.4% - 1% of every sale you help close through pre-purchase chat, phone

call, follow-up
, or abandoned-cart recovery. Organic website checkouts

where you didn't interact with the customer don't count.

- Review bonus: $10 per published Trustpilot review you bring in from

post-purchase calls

- There's no cap. The more you close, the more you make. Strong performers clear

$800/month and up.

Hours: 9 AM to 5 PM EST, Mon to Fri (US business hours)

Tools we use: Go High Level CRM for phone, text, and live chat.

How you'll learn the role: written SOPs and short video walkthroughs for both

stores, plus a few live training calls with me in your first week or two. The

first month is paid learning time, so curiosity and willingness to learn count.

To apply, please submit:

1. Internet speed test result (50 Mbps+ preferred)

2. Typing speed test result (40+ WPM preferred)

3. One paragraph of your written English

4. A 45-second audio sample. Don't just introduce yourself, sell me. Pretend I'm

a customer on the phone, on the fence about a $4,500 log splitter, and I ask:

"Why shouldn't I just grab the cheaper one at my local store?" Talk me into

feeling good about the bigger purchase.

5. In 3-4 sentences: tell me about the best sale you ever closed, or a tough

customer you turned around. What did you actually do?

6. Your IQ score from your profile (required)

7. Your contact info

Put your favorite dessert in the subject line so I know you actually read this.

If your English is excellent, say so. I bump base pay for standout candidates.

Looking forward to it.

Facundo

Produce multiple variations of an ad so we can test hooks and angles.

/Instagram), ideally for eCommerce/DTC brands.

A portfolio of ad creatives you've cut — bonus if any of them were profitable/scaled ads.

Strong command of Premiere Pro or CapCut (After Effects a plus).

An eye for pacing, hooks, and retention — you understand what makes a paid ad perform, not just look pretty.

Reliable, communicative, and able to hit deadlines consistently.

Good written English for clear back-and-forth.

Nice to have



Experience with UGC-style ads.

Meta Ads Media Buyer for E-Commerce Growth



Job Title

Expert Meta Ads Media Buyer – Scale E-Commerce ROAS from 2.57x to 5.5x



Job Description



About Us



Geurwolkje is a fast-growing aromatherapy e-commerce brand selling premium essential oils and diffusers to consumers in the Netherlands and Belgium. We're scaling rapidly through Meta Ads
 & Instagram and need a talented media buyer to help us optimize our advertising efficiency to the next level.



Current Situation:



Monthly Ad Spend: €13,000

Current ROAS: 2.57x

Target ROAS Phase 1: 3.5x in 4 weeks

Target ROAS Phase 2: 5.5x in 8 weeks



The Challenge



We've identified three major bottlenecks in our account that need immediate optimization:



Hook Uniformity & Audience Fatigue

Many of our ads use the same messaging "RESET15", causing audience fatigue and lower CTR. We need someone who understands that the same video with 4 different psychological hooks Sleep, Stress Relief, Seasonal Reset, Social Proof can reach different audience segments and significantly reduce CPA.

Funnel Drop-Off in High-Traffic Campaigns

One campaign generates 1,120 Add to Carts but only 173 purchases 76% drop-off. This is a Value Optimization problem—we're attracting clickers, not buyers. We need someone who can diagnose and fix this.

Inefficient Retargeting

Our retargeting campaign has the worst ROAS 1.96x and highest CPA €23.82 of all campaigns. It should be our most profitable. We need strategic fixes: exclude recent buyers, strengthen the offer, and use better messaging.

title: Retention & Reactivation Call Specialist (Telehealth / Pharmacy)

This role is focused on outbound customer activation through warm and hot calls. Your primary goal is to convert existing customer demand into revenue by re-engaging users, recovering abandoned purchases, increasing repeat orders, and improving retention.



We are not looking for a traditional call center agent.

?

?

?

?

title: Video Editor for 8 Figure Ecommerce Brand
description:
Summary

Our brand is looking for a full-time Direct Response Video Editor to join our fast-growing e-commerce team!

As our video editor, you will be responsible for turning raw footage, UGC, stock, and briefs into high-converting ads that run across Meta, TikTok, and other paid channels. You’ll work closely with our creative strategists to bring concepts to life, iterate quickly, and deliver engaging ads that resonate with our target audience (primarily consumers aged 40+).

This isn’t just about editing — it’s about creating ads that convert. We’re looking for someone with a deep understanding of direct response marketing who can combine speed, creativity, and attention to detail to produce scroll-stopping videos that perform.







Who Are We?

We are dedicated to building innovative wellness devices that improve people’s lives. Since our launch, we’ve grown rapidly through viral digital marketing, building a passionate community of customers who love our products.

We operate with a lean, high-performance team focused on innovation and growth. Now, we’re excited to bring on a video editor to help us scale further by producing top-performing ads week in and week out.







What is Our Culture Like & Who Is a Good Fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring!

We live by the following 4 core values: "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king", and "better every day". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow.

If you’re looking for a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn’t it. But if you want to challenge yourself, sharpen your editing skills, and play a huge role in scaling a brand to $20M+ a year, you’ll love it here.

You’ll be working directly with strategists and founders, producing ads that reach millions of people every month. You’ll join a passionate, smart, and hardworking team with zero politics, no corporate nonsense, and a focus only on results.

If you’re hands-on, proactive, and excited to create ads that actually convert — while being rewarded with an excellent performance-based bonus plan — then you’ve come to the right place.







Key Objectives

- Edit 8-15 minutes of direct response video ads per week.

- Produce 3 variants of hooks for each concept for testing.

- Apply platform best practices (Meta/TikTok safe zones, pacing, etc.).

- Collaborate with creative strategists to bring briefs/scripts to life.

- Turn raw UGC/testimonials into polished, engaging ads.

- Implement clear CTAs, captions, and motion graphics as per SOP.

- Deliver edits in Frame/Trello with proper organization & naming conventions.

- Iterate quickly on feedback and resubmit within 24h when revisions are required.







Requirements

- Fully remote, flexible schedule.

- Fluent in English (written and spoken).

- Direct Response Expertise: 2+ years editing for DTC/e-commerce brands or agencies.

- Strong portfolio of paid social ads (Meta/TikTok a must).

- Proficiency with Adobe Premiere, After Effects (or DaVinci/CapCut if equally strong).

- Ability to edit fast without sacrificing quality.

- Skilled in text animations, captions, pacing, and effects that drive engagement.

- Understanding of performance-driven editing (knowing what makes people stop scrolling).

- Experience with AI tools (voice cloning, Arcads, Runway, etc.).

- Prior experience in generating clips and full videos with AI (Veo, Kling, GPT…) like the viral cartoon ads or clay ads







Accountabilities

- Deliver high-quality edits on time — no missed deadlines.

- Complete revisions within 24h of feedback.

- Follow brand guidelines (colors, fonts, captions).

- Attention to details, make sure to start your application or include in the title the word White

- Ensure every video is engaging, entertaining, and never boring.

- Maintain organized project files, naming conventions, and Frame/Trello workflow.

- Constantly push creative limits and bring fresh editing ideas.







How Our Hiring Works

Step 1: Initial interview (mindset, experience, portfolio review).

Step 2: Skill Assessment Test + Review Interview

Step 3: Final culture & expectations interview.



We hire within 7–10 days of starting interviews and value fast communication.







Salary Expectation Range

USD $15,000 – $30,000 per year (depending on experience) + performance-based bonuses.



Deliverables

• Screening Questions

• When applying, please answer these:



•  1. What about this role attracted you?

• 2. How many years of experience you have editing ads for e-commerce brands?

• 3. Can you share some e-commerce brands you worked with in the past that we may know?

• 4. Share a link to your portfolio (must include different formats like AI videos like cartoon ads, VSLs, UGC, reels…).

• 5. How many minutes of video editing you are able to do in a full week of work? (For example if you do x5 2 minutes video, it will be 10 minutes of editing)

• 6. Which editing tools do you use daily?

• 7. How do you handle tight deadlines and last-minute revisions?

• 8. Are you ok working on weekends or overtime, when needed?

• 9. What fixed monthly rate would make this role work for you? (keep in mind there will be big bonuses based on the performance as well)

We are an AI-powered lifestyle management platform built for the world’s highest-performance founders, athletes, and family offices. Think of it as the operating system for someone’s entire personal life, travel, dining, exclusive experiences, luxury goods, and wellness all managed in one place by a team that genuinely goes the extra mile.



This is a role with a real growth path. If you want to grow into a leadership position, not just do a job, strong performers here will be the first in line to step up as the team scales.



What This Role Actually Looks Like

Here’s a concrete example. A member is flying to New York for three days. Their itinerary: check in to the Four Seasons, dinner at Nobu, a visit to the Met.

A good assistant books those things. You do something different.



You call the Four Seasons’ guest relations team, build a quick rapport, and arrange for two bottles of Dom Pérignon to be waiting in the room with a handwritten welcome card from the company.

Nobu is fully booked. You find the right contact, introduce yourself professionally, and get the table anyway - because you know how to talk to people who matter.

You reach out to the Met’s private tours team and arrange for a dedicated art historian to personally guide the member through the galleries, with refreshments waiting.



That’s the standard. Every member, every trip.

PTO, Wellbeing Stipend, Growth path into a leadership role

Core Responsibilities

* Take a member’s confirmed plans and elevate them, coordinating room amenities, securing hard-to-get reservations, arranging private access, and adding personal touches that make the experience extraordinary.

* Make outbound calls to hotels, restaurants, venues, and luxury service providers in the US, UK, and beyond. Representing the company with confidence and professionalism on every call.

You’re Perfect for This Role If You

title: AI Creative Editor / UGC Video Producer for E-Commerce Ads
description:
WE ONLY LOOK FOR PEOPLE WHO ARE REALLY WILLING TO WORK AND GROW.



We're an established team of 10 people running high-volume direct-response ad creative for our own portfolio of e-commerce brands and products across multiple markets. These are our own products — we're not an agency making ads for clients. We're a very driven crew, always testing new products and always looking for new and better solutions — and we mostly produce AI ads. The way we make creative now starts with AI image and video generation, finished with editing and on-brand text overlays.

We're looking for a sharp, detail-oriented creative who's excited about AI tools, wants to grow with us as the workflow evolves, and — just as importantly — comes up with their own solutions. We don't want someone who only waits for instructions; we want someone who spots a better way to do something and brings it to the table.



This is not a "just cut clips together" role. You'll be operating an AI creative pipeline end to end — turning prompts and references we provide into scroll-stopping ads that convert cold traffic. You'll start by making ads to test new products, and there's real room to grow from there (see below).

What You'll Do



Generate AI images & keyframes from prompts/references we provide (we use Higgsfield + Soul ID / Soul 2.0 for consistent characters — experience with similar tools is fine, we'll train you on ours).



Turn images into video using AI image-to-video tools (we use Kling, including Lip Sync for talking-head UGC).

Create and sync voiceover audio (we use ElevenLabs) and match it cleanly to video.



Write, adapt and overlay headlines & text — not just placing text we give you, but writing and adjusting the headlines on image ads yourself so they hit harder. Hide existing on-screen text and add new text in the correct language, using Canva and/or Figma. Clean, pixel-accurate overlays matter.



Work with hooks that already work — take proven, winning hooks and apply or adapt them to new image ads. The hook is the most important part of any ad, so this is a core part of the job.

Build scroll-stoppers — strong hooks in the first 1–2 seconds to stop the feed.

Combine and re-edit clips into fresh, high-quality ad creatives.

Optimize every deliverable for Meta 
/Instagram) and TikTok ad placements.

Deliver on time, follow briefs precisely, and keep quality high and consistent.



What We're Looking For



Hands-on experience with AI creative tools — this is a must. Image and/or video generation (e.g. Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, Midjourney, Sora, ElevenLabs, Soul, or similar). You don't need to know our exact stack, but you must already be working with AI tools, not just curious about them.

Experience writing and working with prompts — also a must. You're comfortable crafting and tweaking prompts to get the output you want, and ideally with structured prompt files (JSON).

A solutions-first mindset. You don't just execute tasks — you spot problems, test ideas, and bring better ways of doing things to the team.

Solid video editing skills in tools like CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, 
, or similar.

Comfort with Canva and/or Figma for text overlays and basic design.

An understanding of human psychology — you get why people stop, click and buy. You can write and tweak headlines and hooks that tap into real emotions and motivations, not just text that "sounds nice."

A strong eye for direct-response e-commerce ads — you understand what makes an ad stop the scroll and convert, not just what looks "pretty."

Excellent attention to detail and the ability to follow detailed instructions and briefs.

Fluent English and clear communication with our team.

Reliable, organized, and able to hit deadlines consistently.



Big Bonus Skills (Not Required, But Highly Valued)



AI UGC video — selfie/confessional, problem-to-solution, talking-head, before/after transformations made with AI. This is not required, but it's a fast-growing part of what we do. If you can produce great AI UGC, it will set you apart and earn you extra bonuses and more work.

Experience with Meta / TikTok ad creative specifically.

Additional languages — especially Swedish or Finnish — for localization work.

A track record of producing creatives at volume.



Room to Grow (and Earn More)

This role has a clear path forward for people who deliver:



Test-product ad creator — where you start. You make ads to test new products across our brands.

UGC creator — as you prove yourself, you can move into producing AI UGC content, which earns more.

Winning ads creator — the top track: building and scaling the proven, high-performing ads. This is the highest-earning level.



If you're driven and your work performs, you won't stay in one place — you'll grow into more responsibility and better pay.

How to Apply



Share your portfolio — examples of your previous work, ideally e-commerce ads, UGC-style content, or AI-generated image/video. If you've made anything with AI tools, show us.

In one or two sentences, in your own words, tell us which AI tool you've enjoyed using most and why. (We're looking for a real answer, not a generated one.)

Start your application with the word NORTHSTAR so we know you actually read this post and aren't mass-applying.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Scaledforce

Scaledforce is a Canadian staffing company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our tea
mbers can build stable, fulfilling and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You will support the COO of a fast-growing start up based in Canada that provides premium technology products to universities, healthcare centers, and large corporations across North America. With roughly 100 clients, 95% of the customer base in the US, and expansion into the UK underway, the company is scaling quickly into its next phase of growth.



The COO has been heads-down building the business from day one — wearing every hat, handling every
, and managing every renewal. That’s no longer sustainable. He needs a sharp, reliable operator to take day-to-day admin off his plate so he can shift his focus to strategy and growth. This is not a corporate environment — it’s a lean, scrappy team that moves fast and rewards people who take ownership.



Job Overview

We are looking for a part-time, remote Executive Assistant who will own the COO’s inbox, manage client renewal administration, coordinate with the external bookkeeping team, and help build the SOPs that don’t exist yet. You will also support recruiting operations, website content, and other operational tasks as the business grows.



This is not a “sit and wait for instructions” role. You will be expected to learn fast, triage independently, and take ownership of your lanes from week one. The right person treats every task — whether it’s chasing a university procurement form or drafting an
 in the COO’s voice — with equal precision and urgency.



Work Schedule

•      Monday to Friday

•      10:00 AM – 7:00 PM EST (Eastern Standard Time)

•      Philippine Time: approximately 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM PHT



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary: PHP ?36,000 – ?42,000 per month

Quarterly Bonuses: Performance-based quarterly bonuses



Key Responsibilities

 & Calendar Management

•      Manage and organize the COO’s inbox daily (G Suite) — triage, categorize, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

•      Draft
 replies that match the COO’s voice and tone; send independently once trust is established

•      Schedule and coordinate meetings across time zones

•      Prepare a daily brief before the COO starts his day — who he’s meeting, why, and what the goal is for each conversation



Renewal & Procurement Administration

•      Track client renewals via HubSpot and internal spreadsheets

•      Follow up on invoices sent through QuickBooks (issued 3 months in advance)

•      Navigate university and corporate procurement systems, vendor registration portals, and contracting workflows

•      Route signature requests and flag legal or tax clauses for COO review

•      Handle check image management and reconciliation with the external bookkeeper



Light Bookkeeping & AP Support

•      Coordinate with the external bookkeeping service on escalations

•      Assist with cross-border (Canada–US) wire transfer verification and documentation

•      Respond to accounts payable inquiries from client finance teams



Lead Generation & CRM Management

•      Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, AI research tools, and other sources

•      Enrich contact data and log prospects into HubSpot with accurate tagging and notes

•      Maintain CRM hygiene — update deal stages, flag stalled opportunities, and ensure pipeline data stays current

•      Prepare pre-call briefs and post-call follow-up
s fro
eting notes



LinkedIn Content & Social Media

•      Draft and schedule LinkedIn posts on behalf of leadership — thought leadership, industry insights, and company updates

•      Monitor and engage with comments, messages, and relevant conversations on LinkedIn

•      Repurpose internal insights and call takeaways into social content



Website Content & SEO

•      Write and publish blog posts and website content on Webflow

•      Support on-page SEO optimization (meta titles, descriptions, internal linking)

•      Research keywords and content topics relevant to the business

General Admin & SOP Building

•      Document and build SOPs for recurring processes (especially the renewal lifecycle) — this is greenfield work and critical to scaling the business

•      Handle personal admin tasks as needed (reservations, appointments, personal scheduling

•      Support workflow improvements and identify opportunities for automation over time

•      Assist with additional operational tasks as the business grows



Qualifications

Required:

•      At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant or Virtual Assistant supporting a US or Canadian founder, CEO, or senior executive

•      Strong written English — you will draft professional
s, client correspondence, and content daily

•      Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets)

•      Proven ability to manage someone else’s
 inbox and calendar with discretion and good judgment

•      Experience with procurement, renewals, invoicing, or accounts payable processes

•      Experience with HubSpot (CRM) — navigating contacts, deals, and logging activities

•      Proactive mindset — you anticipate needs, spot problems before they escalate, and take initiative without waiting to be asked

•      High degree of discretion and confidentiality

•      Reliable internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace



Nice to Have:

•      Experience building lead lists and managing prospect data in a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, or similar), including contact enrichment and pipeline hygiene

•      Experience creating and scheduling LinkedIn content or managing social media accounts on behalf of a founder or executive, including community engagement

•      Experience writing blog posts or website content and working with Webflow or a similar CMS platform, including basic on-page SEO optimization

•      Experience preparing sales proposals, pitch decks, or client-facing collateral from templates or call notes

•      Familiarity with QuickBooks or similar invoicing/bookkeeping tools

•      Familiarity with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and a willingness to incorporate them into daily workflows

•      Background working in SaaS, technology, staffing, or agency environments

•      Exposure to cross-border (US/Canada) payment workflows



Who Thrives in This Role

•      You love being the person who keeps everything running — you get genuine satisfaction from creating order out of complexity

•      You’re resourceful and scrappy — this is a bootstrapped company, not a big corporate environment, and you thrive in that kind of setting

•      You learn new tools and systems fast — one walkthrough and you’re running

•      You communicate clearly and concisely — you summarize, you don’t ramble

•      You’re comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and course-correcting as you learn

•      You take ownership — when something is in your lane, you run it without being micromanaged

•      You’re patient with legacy systems (universities still send checks) and energized by building processes from scratch where SOPs don’t exist yet

•      You understand that “80% done by someone else is 100% awesome” — speed and action matter more than perfection

•      Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

•      Quiet, dedicated home workspace with a desk



Why Join Scaledforce

•      Netflix subscription reimbursement



How to Apply (Important)

 the following to

title: Full Stack Platform Engineer
description:
Our company is an English teaching platform. We offer 1 on 1 classes hosted on Google Meet. Our course material is set and students can pick up where they last left off with any teacher on the platform, allowing them to take classes based on their availability. Alongside our coursework we have additional practices, and an application we built to allow them to continue learning outside of the live sessions.



Students come onto the platform and can book these 1 on 1 sessions based on the availability on the site. This booking can be done through our calendar where they choose a time availability and then a teacher that is available within that time, or they can choose a specific teacher and then book based on their availability. 



For our teachers they place their availability in the system, students can then book one hour long live lessons based on that availability. Teachers have the ability to unlock lessons for the students from their dashboard after a class is completed so that students can view their new practices/resources for the completed class. Teachers can also leave notes on students so that the next teacher can pick up where the previous teacher left off.



From our admin panel we have the ability to edit our landing page, add or take away teachers, delete students or add credits to their account, change our pricing of our packages, add content and lessons, we have an overview of some analytics, and a few other additional features.



Our system works based on credits, students can buy individual or packages of credits. Our transactions are currently conducted through stripe. A single credit is deducted from students' credits when a class is booked. When a teacher teaches a live class they will have $10 added to their payout balance. The system is then meant to recognize how much the teacher is owed for the week and automatically pay them out on Sunday from our stripe balance. Our system also automatically generates the Google meets link for both our student and teacher, based off the booking they made on our platform. Our system has some set rules for booking and cancellations that it automatically applies. Additionally, our system sends automated reminders and confirmations for classes.



What we are looking for:

Someone to come and resolve our current issues, and potentially add additional features. 



Focus Role:



Full Stack Platform Engineer / SaaS Product Developer



1. Define the Primary Objectives



The purpose of this role is to:



Stabilize the current platform infrastructure

Resolve production-level payment and booking issues

Improve scheduling/calendar functionality

Improve teacher and student user experience

Implement scalable company account functionality

Expand reporting, analytics, and administrative tools

Improve mobile responsiveness and multilingual support



The developer should be capable of both:



Debugging existing systems

Building scalable new product features

2. Immediate Priority Issues (Critical Fixes)

A. Stripe Automatic Payout Failure



Current issue:



Teachers are not receiving automatic Sunday payouts despite successful student payments through Stripe.



Developer responsibilities:



Audit Stripe Connect configuration

Review payout automation logic

Review webhook handling and cron jobs

Review failed payout logs

Verify international payout support for Latin America and USA

Implement reliable payout retry/error handling

Ensure payout tracking visibility inside admin dashboard



Expected outcome:



Fully automated, stable weekly teacher payouts

B. Student Booking Error



Current issue:



Students attempting to book available classes receive:

“Slot not available or already booked”



Developer responsibilities:



Audit booking transaction logic

Review concurrency/duplicate booking handling

Review database slot locking logic

Verify frontend/backend slot synchronization

Improve booking reliability and error messaging



Expected outcome:



Students can reliably book available classes without false conflicts

C. Teacher Timezone & Availability Issues



Current issue:



Teacher availability dates shift incorrectly for some users.



Example:



Thursday May 28 displays as Wednesday May 27.



Developer responsibilities:



Audit timezone conversion logic

Verify UTC storage handling

Review frontend/browser timezone interpretation

Standardize timezone behavior across devices

Ensure teacher local time displays correctly to students in their own timezone



Expected outcome:



Accurate global scheduling across all user regions

D. Stripe Teacher Connection Errors



Current issues:



Some teachers cannot connect Stripe

Some cannot reconnect/disconnect

“Stripe Connected” remains incorrectly

Teachers receive onboarding errors



Developer responsibilities:



Rebuild Stripe onboarding flow

Improve onboarding validation and logging

Improve user-facing error handling



Expected outcome:



Reliable Stripe onboarding and reconnection flow

E. Calendar Slot Generation



Current issue:



Continuous availability is not splitting into bookable hourly classes.



Example:



3PM–6PM should automatically create:

3PM–4PM

4PM–5PM

5PM–6PM



Developer responsibilities:



Create automatic slot generation logic

Prevent duplicate or overlapping slots

Ensure slots display correctly for students and teachers



Expected outcome:



Fully functional class slot generation system

F. Form Validation Improvements



Current issue:



Users receive generic “Error” or “Zod Error” messages.



Developer responsibilities:



Create field-specific validation messages

Improve onboarding UX

Improve frontend validation handling



Expected outcome:



Clear, actionable form error messages

G. Mobile & UX Improvements

Mobile PDF Issue

PDFs do not display correctly on phones

Language Switcher

Mobile language switcher missing

Spanish should be default option for Spanish-speaking users

Student Payment/Booking Flow

Students sometimes receive payment redirect errors despite successful purchases



Developer responsibilities:



Improve mobile responsiveness

Improve multilingual UX

Improve post-payment flow handling

Improve session persistence and redirects



Expected outcome:



Stable and mobile-friendly user experience

3. Secondary Platform Improvements

A. Admin Credit Controls

Admins can add credits but cannot remove them.

Create full credit adjustment system

Add audit logs for credit changes

B. Platform Messaging Accuracy

title: Direct-Response Meta Ads Video Editor Needed for 10 Dental Marketing Ads
description:
I’m looking for a strong video editor to edit a batch of direct-response Meta ads for my dental marketing agency.



These ads will be used to advertise to dentists / dental practice owners, so they need to feel professional, credible, and production-grade — while still being engaging enough to hold attention on
 and Instagram.



This is not cheap TikTok-style editing. I want clean, premium, direct-response ad editing with strong pacing, captions, overlays, motion graphics, and visual callouts that make the message easier to understand and more engaging.



Project details:



- 10 core talking-head Meta ads

- Final format should be 9:16 vertical

- Each ad will be around 1 minute, some slightly longer

- Footage is me speaking directly to camera in a well-lit setup with a professional background / accent lighting

- Some ads may have 2-3 hook/body variations

- Raw footage will be clearly labeled

- CTA will mostly be the same across the ads

- This is primarily 10 core edits, with some simple hook/body variations — not 20 fully separate custom ads



What I need:



- Strong pacing and tight cuts

- Removal of dead space, mistakes, awkward pauses, repeated lines, etc.

- Clean audio processing

- Professional captions/subtitles

- Branded overlays and visual callouts

- Motion graphics that improve retention and understanding

- Visual emphasis on key claims, numbers, offers, and important points

- Hook/body/CTA structure edited clearly

- Smooth transitions that feel premium, not gimmicky

- Final ads that feel credible enough to show to dentists and dental practice owners



The ads are direct-response ads, so the structure is usually:



- Hook

- Body

- CTA



Some hooks and bodies will have multiple versions. I will label the raw footage clearly so you know which hooks go with which bodies. I need someone who can stitch these together cleanly and make the final ads feel polished.



Timeline:



This is a priority project and I need it completed quickly. Ideally, I’m looking for a 48-hour turnaround or faster if possible.



I’m willing to pay fairly for speed and quality, but please only apply if you can realistically deliver polished work on this timeline.



Budget:



Budget is around $200-$300 fixed price for the batch.



This should be priced as 10 core ads with some simple hook/body variations, not as 20 fully separate custom ads.



Ideal person:



You should have experience editing:



- Direct-response video ads

- Meta /
 / Instagram ads

- Talking-head ads

- UGC-style or founder-led ads

- Professional B2B or service-based ads

- Videos with captions, overlays, motion graphics, and visual callouts



To apply, please send:



- 2-3 relevant examples of direct-response ads you’ve edited

- Whether you can complete the first batch within 48 hours

- How quickly you can start

- Your price for the full project

- What software you edit in

- How many revisions are included

- Whether you have experience editing ads for B2B, agencies, dentists, healthcare, or professional services



Bonus if you can briefly explain how you approach pacing, hooks, captions, retention, and visual callouts for Meta ads.

Women with 10,000–500,000 followers on TikTok and/or Instagram

Posts fitness, gym, lifestyle, or health and wellness content

• Monitor and analyse performance daily/weekly, making proactive adjustments to improve lead quality and ROI - not just volume



• Produce clear, insight-led reports for internal review and client-facing use, translating data into plain-English recommendations



• Manage advertising budgets responsibly, with strong attention to pacing, allocation, and wastage



• Contribute to the development and documentation of our agency’s paid media SOPs - helping to standardise what works across the portfolio



• Join daily Zoom calls with the UK team and maintain clear written communication throughout



TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIRED

• Meta Ads: Confident use of Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager. Solid understanding of campaign objectives, audience structure, and budget management (CBO/ABO). Working knowledge of CAPI and conversion event setup. Genuine understanding of what creative formats and hooks perform in Meta auctions - not just theory.



• Google Ads: Hands-on experience managing Search, Performance Max, and ideally Demand Gen campaigns. Comfortable using Google Ads Editor for bulk changes and managing accounts at scale. Experience with Smart Bidding strategies and an understanding of when and why to use them.



• Tracking & Analytics: GA4 for campaign performance analysis. Solid understanding of conversion tracking setup, UTM parameters, and cross-platform attribution. Ability to identify tracking gaps and flag them.



• Automation & Reporting: Familiarity with automation tools such as Zapier or N8N. Ability to use API or MCP connections to pull data and generate reports or workflow automations. This doesn’t need to be at the developer level, but you should be comfortable working with these tools in practice.



• CRO Awareness: An understanding of the full journey from ad to conversion - able to identify whether underperformance sits in the ad, the landing page, or the offer, and brief accordingly.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

• Graduate-level education (or equivalent) in marketing, advertising, or a related field, with a strong foundation in digital advertising and analytics

• Experience with other advertising platforms, e.g. Pinterest Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads

• Knowledge of organic principles to complement paid campaigns

• Certification in Google Ads or Meta Blueprint

• Familiarity with CRM tools and
 marketing platforms

• Experience in a marketing agency or with multi-client projects



IDEAL CANDIDATE ATTRIBUTES

• High attention to detail, ensuring accurate and high-quality work

• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple projects effectively

• Ability to work methodically and apply the same standards across multiple clients

• Task-focused attitude, with the drive to complete projects efficiently

• High level of written and spoken English

• Willing and able to attend daily Zoom calls

• Strong & reliable broadband connection, with a backup connection ideally available.

• Home working environment is professional, without distractions

• Appreciation for interior design is a bonus



WHY JOIN US

• Full-time: 40 hours/week (afternoon/early evening PH time)

• Competitive salary: $10-20 per hour, based on skills and experience

• Opportunity to learn and grow within a forward-thinking UK marketing agency



HOW TO APPLY

• Submit a 150+ word cover note on why you’re a good fit for this role and why it interests you. Include a link to your CV.



RECRUITMENT SCHEDULE

• Applications close – 25th May

• Video interviews conducted on Zoom – week commencing 25th May

• Role commences – Early June

title: 7 Figure Business Ad Creative Editor (Needed for Script Execution)
description:
We run a high-volume direct response operation and need an editor who genuinely understands how DR ads work — not just someone who makes things look good, but someone who edits with the sell in mind.

This is a long-term role. If you're the right fit, you'll have consistent weekly work and room to grow with us.



What You'll Be Doing

Editing raw footage into high-converting ad creatives that run on Meta 
/Instagram). You will receive scripts — no B-roll guidance, no asset folders, no hand-holding. Sourcing the right supporting content is entirely on you. This is one of the most important parts of the job and how we separate good editors from great ones. Your edits need to serve the argument, not just fill the screen.



As you grow into the role, you'll also be expected to learn and execute AI-generated talking head creatives and to use AI video B-roll generators to source and create supporting footage. We'll walk you through our process, but you need to come in already comfortable with AI tools — and curious and coachable enough to push them further.



Who We're Looking For

You've edited paid ad creatives before — not just YouTube or social content, but ads built to convert

You understand why B-roll choices matter in DR — you're reinforcing belief, not decorating

You can explain why an edit works, not just execute it

You're resourceful with content sourcing — stock footage, B-roll libraries, sound design, you know where to find what you need without being pointed to it

You're open to learning new workflows, specifically AI talking head creative production

You're fast, reliable, and don't need to be chased for deliverables

You take feedback well and bring ideas to the table

You're honest about your skill level and won't waste either of our time

Comfortable with tools like CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar

You already have hands-on skills with AI tools and know how to fold them into a real editing workflow

You can use AI video B-roll generators to create supporting footage that reinforces the sell — not just generic filler



How to Apply (Read Carefully)

We don't do traditional applications. This is a trial-based hiring process — we care about what you can do, not what your resume says.

Step 1 — Send us a message and include the word GOAT so we know you actually read this post. We'll send you a creative brief.

Step 2 — Using the brief, create a trial ad. This is your audition. Show us what you can do — and how fast you can do it. Speed and quality both matter.

Step 3 — If your trial submission is approved, we'll schedule an interview to discuss the role, pay structure, and next steps.

title: Part-Time Chargeback Specialist for Fashion Dropshipping Store (Shopify)
description:
Hi, my name is Sam! I'm looking for an experienced Chargeback Specialist to take over the chargeback handling for my Shopify fashion dropshipping store. I currently spend too much time on this myself and need someone reliable to manage the full process for me.



About the role:

You will be responsible for handling all incoming chargebacks via Shopify Payments. This includes gathering evidence (proof of delivery, IP data, tracking, customer communication, payment authentication data), building structured rebuttal packages, and submitting them through the Shopify dispute portal in English.



Workload:

This is a part-time position. The volume of chargebacks is manageable, not extreme, so the weekly hours are limited. However, there is real potential for this to grow into a full-time role as the business scales, and additional related tasks may be added over time for the right person.



Compensation:

Starting rate: $5 USD per hour. Performance-based raises are possible once you've proven your value.



Required experience:

- Proven experience handling Shopify chargebacks (fraudulent, item not received, item not as described)

- Previous work with multiple dropshipping companies, ideally in the fashion dropshipping niche, similar to mine

- Strong understanding of evidence requirements: 3D Secure, CVC checks, AVS, tracking and proof of delivery, network authorization data

- Familiarity with Shopify Admin, Shopify Payments, and the dispute submission process

- Excellent written English (rebuttals are submitted in English)

- Detail-oriented, organized, able to work independently



Bonus if you have:

- Experience with Gorgias, supplier communication for POD requests, experience with AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude 

- Familiarity with the EU/Spanish market

- Your own work sheets, trackers, or templates that you use to keep chargeback cases organized



How to apply:

To prove you've read this entire post carefully, please start your application with the word "apple". Applications without this will be ignored.



In your application, include:

1. The word "apple" at the very top

2. A short overview of the dropshipping stores you've worked with (industry, platform, your role)

3. Your approximate win rate on chargebacks and how many you've handled

4. Your weekly availability

5. Any questions you have for me



Looking forward to hearing from you!
